subject: ISV performance kickers, lead registration ops, and rebate mechanics
messages:
From: Alexei Kuznetsov <alexei@luminaisv.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Hi Naomi / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about embedding Redwood for low-latency inference inside our connector product. Before we move to a pilot, I wanted to propose a commercial structure that mixes a baseline referral rebate with a variable "performance kicker" tied to monthly activated usage and lead registration hygiene.

High-level ask: can Redwood offer a tiered rebate (2% baseline + up to +6% kicker) where the kicker pays out when Lumina-sourced prospects hit usage thresholds in the first 90 days, and where lead registration validation (timely registration + proof of intro) preserves the rebate? We want the kicker to be simple to administer on both sides and to avoid manual disputes.

Quick notes on what matters to us:
- Clear definitions: what counts as "activated usage" vs trials; lookback window; account-level aggregation.
- Lead registration flow: API-based registration preferred; timestamped entries prevent double-claims.
- Clawback windows: we expect a 180-day clawback for churn/chargebacks.

I attached a one-page sketch of the proposed tiers. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Alexei
Alexei Kuznetsov
Head of GTM, LuminaISV
[attachment: Draft_Performance_Kicker_Termsheet_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alexei Kuznetsov <alexei@luminaisv.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Alexei — thanks for the clear sketch and for laying out the operational constraints. This model is workable in principle; a couple of operational clarifications we need to lock down so finance and revenue ops can automate payouts: 

1) Activation definition: propose "activated usage" = first 24 hours with >= 10k inference tokens AND conversion to a paid Redwood plan within 90 days. We can also treat dedicated capacity trials separately.
2) Registration flow: we can provide a Lead Registration API endpoint + optional spreadsheet ingest for older deals. Time-stamped registration plus IP/email match should be sufficient for automated validation.
3) Kicker mechanics: baseline rebate 2% of recognized Redwood net revenue from Lumina-referred customers; kicker tiers at +2% (>= $10k MRR), +4% (>= $30k MRR), +6% (>= $80k MRR) measured in the first 90 days post-activation. Payout quarterly with a 180-day clawback window.

I attached a redline of your sketch with the definitions above and a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can run to POC the flow. If that looks good we can route to finance and legal for a lightweight MOU and then a pilot SOW.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm activation definition and tiers by EOD Wed (18 Aug)
- We provision a Lead Registration API test key and a HubSpot integration sample
- Mid-august pilot start (2-week technical onboarding, 8-week pilot measurement)

Looping Ben and Camila for ops and payouts confirmation.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Partners, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Lumina_MOU.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Forwarding Naomi's reply — fyi my read on the payout mechanics and impact to our rev ops:

- The cliffed tiers are fine, but we need a small ops note: avoid monthly micro-payouts under $500; aggregate at quarter level to keep finance overhead reasonable.
- Clawback mechanics need explicit mapping to revenue reversals in our accounting system; I recommend we use a single GL account for partner rebates to simplify reconciliation.
- We might be able to accommodate a higher kicker (up to +8%) if Lumina commits to a short-term marketing co-fund ($25k) and a 6-month minimum trial MRR commitment. That shifts some risk to Lumina and speeds adoption.

Ben — can you confirm whether a HubSpot integration + LeadReg API is sufficient for automated validation, or whether we need additional manual gating?

Camila

-----Original Message-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Sent: Tuesday, August 17, 2027 9:15 AM
To: Alexei Kuznetsov <alexei@luminaisv.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Camila / Naomi — quick confirmation from rev ops side: HubSpot webhooks + our Lead Registration API should be sufficient for automated validation provided Lumina ensures the timestamped form fields include a proof_of_intro_email and a source_id matching their CRM. We can run a daily reconciliation job that outputs a CSV to S3 for Lumina to pull.

Two operational asks:
- If Lumina expects a faster kicker band (e.g., +8%) we require a short written marketing co-fund and a signed SOW that includes minimum trial MRR (we can model that as a minimum payable threshold).
- Clawback implementation: revenue reversals will be netted against future partner payouts; any amounts outstanding after 12 months will be written off per policy unless Lumina requests a longer term in writing.

I can spin up a sample reconciliation run and an automated validation checklist by Thursday.

Ben
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alexei Kuznetsov <alexei@luminaisv.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumenia Sales Ops <salesops@luminaisv.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Thanks Naomi / Camila / Ben — this is exactly the sort of structure we were hoping for. We agree to the activation def, tier thresholds, and the 180-day clawback window. We can commit the $25k marketing co-fund if Redwood opens the kicker to +8% for the top tier (>= $80k MRR within 90 days).

Two follow-ups from our side:
1) Can you share the Lead Registration API spec and a test key?
2) We'll route the marketing co-fund commitment through procurement but would prefer a lightweight MOU first to capture the 8% conditionality and the co-fund mechanics.

Can we lock a short 30-minute alignment call on Friday to finalize the MAP?

Alexei

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alexei Kuznetsov <alexei@luminaisv.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial model — suggestion for performance kickers + lead reg ops

Alexei — great, thanks for the quick decision. Confirming next steps and links so procurement/legal can move fast: 

1) Lead Registration API spec & test key — provisioning details: https://internal.redwood.com/partner-api/leadreg (test key will be shared in a separate secure message from devops).

Attachments: Lumina_MOU.docx (redlined), Draft_Performance_Kicker_Termsheet_v1.pdf (definitions + example payout schedule).

If this matches your internal procurement timeline, please sign the PowerForm and I'll route a finalized MOU and the HubSpot webhook snippet to your Sales Ops.

Thanks — Naomi
